verdict_text: YES. The script casts exactly the 48 projection matrices matched by a full-match regex to bfloat16, keeps every other tensor float32 with values unchanged, drops only the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers (the regex cannot match `c_attn.bias` or layer-norm biases), preserves names, implements all four required checks as assertions before writing, and packs shards greedily at 64 MiB with an oversized tensor placed alone in its own shard, writing a `model.safetensors.index.json` whose `weight_map` covers every tensor.
